authors.bio: Ernesto Santos is co-founder and CTO at GLOOKAST. He has been managing file-based workflow projects and award-winning product lines since MXF first rolled out into the market. He is a SMPTE Fellow and an active contributor to SMPTE Standards development activities. He led the MXF Implementers Working Group from 2005 to 2008 and has been co-chair of the SMPTE 31FS (File Structures) Technical Committee since June 2008. Before he joined SMPTE, he was also an active participant at ISO/IEC JTC1/SC29/WG11 (MPEG), where he was involved in the development of MPEG-7 and MPEG-21, having been one of the editors of MPEG-21 part 2—Digital Item Declaration. Santos holds a degree in electrical engineering and computer science, with specialization in telecommunications from the Porto University in Portugal.
authors.name: Ernesto Santos

authors.bio: Karen Broome is manager, technology standards, at Sony Electronics. Based in Hollywood, CA, she is co-chair of the SMPTE 31FS Files and Structures Technical Committee, chair of the SMPTE 30MR10 Metadata Definition Working Group, and chair of the SMPTE 3D Home Master Metadata Ad Hoc Group. She represents Sony Electronics in multimedia content and metadata standardization activities in the U.S., including MXF, EPUB (e-book), and Metadata Working Group, and she is an invited expert to the Academy of Motion Pictures Arts and Sciences Metadata and Containers Committee. Broome also works on language identification and codes, participating in two revisions of the RFC defining xml:lang (IETF BCP47). Before joining Sony, Broome managed a digital content strategy business in San Francisco, serving as an advisor on the launch of ground-breaking workflow, taxonomy, and multilingual content delivery systems for CNET, Macromedia, Charles Schwab, and other clients.
authors.name: Karen Broome
